findings.text: SSB_CORE_SIZE fixes the per-core MMIO window at 0x1000 bytes, and SSB_MAX_NR_CORES derives the core ceiling from the enumeration span divided by that window. SSB_EJTAG anchors the MIPS debug window at 0xff200000 with a two megabyte span.

SSB_PMCSR sits at 0x44 with SSB_PE enable at 0x100. SSB_BAR0_WIN at 0x80 and SSB_BAR1_WIN at 0x84 select backplane address spaces, SSB_BAR1_CONTROL at 0x8c tunes bursts for the second space, SSB_SPROMCTL at 0x88 carries SSB_SPROMCTL_WE at 0x10, and interrupts use SSB_PCI_IRQS at 0x90, SSB_PCI_IRQMASK at 0x94 and SSB_BACKPLANE_IRQS at 0x98.

SSB_GPIO_IN at 0xB0, SSB_GPIO_OUT at 0xB4 and SSB_GPIO_OUT_ENABLE at 0xB8 provide input, output and direction for GPIO on capable revisions. Associated bits are SSB_GPIO_SCS at 0x10, SSB_GPIO_HWRAD at 0x20, SSB_GPIO_XTAL at 0x40 and SSB_GPIO_PLL at 0x80. SSB_BAR0_MAX_RETRIES caps window programming retries at 50.

SSB_IPSFLAG at 0x0F08 routes flags to four MIPS interrupts via SSB_IPSFLAG_IRQ1 at 0x3F shift 0, SSB_IPSFLAG_IRQ2 at 0x3F00 shift 8, SSB_IPSFLAG_IRQ3 at 0x3F0000 shift 16 and SSB_IPSFLAG_IRQ4 at 0x3F000000 shift 24. SSB_TPSFLAG at 0x0F18 carries SSB_TPSFLAG_BPFLAG at 0x3F and SSB_TPSFLAG_ALWAYSIRQ at 0x40. Error capture is at SSB_TMERRLOGA 0x0F48 and SSB_TMERRLOG 0x0F50.

Address matching and fabric control use fixed offsets: SSB_ADMATCH1 at 0x0F70, SSB_ADMATCH2 at 0x0F68, SSB_ADMATCH3 at 0x0F60, SSB_ADMATCH0 at 0x0FB0, SSB_BWA0 at 0x0FA0, SSB_BCONFIG at 0x0FC0, SSB_BSTATE at 0x0FC8, SSB_ACTCFG at 0x0FD8, SSB_FLAGST at 0x0FE8, SSB_TMCFGLO at 0x0FB8, SSB_TMCFGHI at 0x0FBC and SSB_IMCFGHI at 0x0FAC.

SSB_IMSTATE at 0x0F90 reports pipe count in SSB_IMSTATE_PC at 0xF, arbitration in SSB_IMSTATE_AP_MASK at 0x30 selecting among SSB_IMSTATE_AP_BOTH at 0, SSB_IMSTATE_AP_TS at 0x10, SSB_IMSTATE_AP_TK at 0x20 and SSB_IMSTATE_AP_RSV at 0x30, plus SSB_IMSTATE_IBE at 0x20000, SSB_IMSTATE_TO at 0x40000, SSB_IMSTATE_BUSY at 0x1800000 and SSB_IMSTATE_REJECT at 0x2000000. SSB_IMCFGLO at 0x0FA8 carries SSB_IMCFGLO_SERTO at 0x7, SSB_IMCFGLO_REQTO at 0x70 shift 4 and SSB_IMCFGLO_CONNID at 0xFF0000 shift 16.

SSB_INTVEC at 0x0F94 gates backplane interrupts with one bit per function: SSB_INTVEC_PCI at 1, SSB_INTVEC_ENET0 at 2, SSB_INTVEC_ILINE20 at 4, SSB_INTVEC_CODEC at 8, SSB_INTVEC_USB at 0x10, SSB_INTVEC_EXTIF at 0x20 and SSB_INTVEC_ENET1 at 0x40.

SSB_TMSLOW at 0x0F98 provides SSB_TMSLOW_RESET at 1, SSB_TMSLOW_REJECT at 2, SSB_TMSLOW_REJECT_23 at 4, SSB_TMSLOW_CLOCK at 0x10000, SSB_TMSLOW_FGC at 0x20000, SSB_TMSLOW_PE at 0x40000000 and SSB_TMSLOW_BE at 0x80000000. SSB_TMSHIGH at 0x0F9C reports SSB_TMSHIGH_SERR at 1, SSB_TMSHIGH_INT at 2, SSB_TMSHIGH_BUSY at 4, SSB_TMSHIGH_TO at 0x20, SSB_TMSHIGH_COREFL at 0x1FFF0000 shift 16, SSB_TMSHIGH_DMA64 at 0x10000000, SSB_TMSHIGH_GCR at 0x20000000, SSB_TMSHIGH_BISTF at 0x40000000 and SSB_TMSHIGH_BISTD at 0x80000000.

SSB_IDLOW at 0x0FF8 packs SSB_IDLOW_CFGSP at 3, SSB_IDLOW_ADDRNGE at 0x38 shift 3, SSB_IDLOW_SYNC at 0x40, SSB_IDLOW_INITIATOR at 0x80, SSB_IDLOW_MIBL at 0xF00 shift 8, SSB_IDLOW_MABL at 0xF000 shift 12, SSB_IDLOW_TIF at 0x10000, SSB_IDLOW_CCW at 0xC0000 shift 18, SSB_IDLOW_TPT at 0xF00000 shift 20, SSB_IDLOW_INITP at 0xF000000 shift 24 and SSB_IDLOW_SSBREV at 0xF0000000 with SSB_IDLOW_SSBREV_22 at 0, SSB_IDLOW_SSBREV_23 at 0x10000000, SSB_IDLOW_SSBREV_24 at 0x40000000, SSB_IDLOW_SSBREV_25 at 0x50000000, SSB_IDLOW_SSBREV_26 at 0x60000000 and SSB_IDLOW_SSBREV_27 at 0x70000000.

SSB_IDHIGH at 0x0FFC carries SSB_IDHIGH_RCLO at 0xF, SSB_IDHIGH_CC at 0x8FF0 shift 4, SSB_IDHIGH_RCHI at 0x7000 shift 8 and SSB_IDHIGH_VC at 0xFFFF0000 shift 16, splitting revision low and high parts around core and vendor codes.

Default SPROM is SSB_SPROMSIZE_WORDS at 64 words with byte size scaled by 16-bit units. Revision sizes are SSB_SPROMSIZE_WORDS_R123 at 64, SSB_SPROMSIZE_WORDS_R4 at 220, SSB_SPROMSIZE_WORDS_R10 at 230 and SSB_SPROMSIZE_WORDS_R11 at 234, with matching byte forms. Bases are SSB_SPROM_BASE1 at 0x1000 and SSB_SPROM_BASE31 at 0x0800. SSB_SPROM_REVISION at 0x007E splits into SSB_SPROM_REVISION_REV at 0xFF and SSB_SPROM_REVISION_CRC at 0xFF00 shift 8.

Revision 1 SPROM starts with SSB_SPROM1_SPID at 0x0004, SSB_SPROM1_SVID at 0x0006 and SSB_SPROM1_PID at 0x0008, then MACs SSB_SPROM1_IL0MAC at 0x0048, SSB_SPROM1_ET0MAC at 0x004E and SSB_SPROM1_ET1MAC at 0x0054. SSB_SPROM1_ETHPHY at 0x005A packs SSB_SPROM1_ETHPHY_ET0A at 0x1F, SSB_SPROM1_ETHPHY_ET1A at 0x3E0 shift 5, SSB_SPROM1_ETHPHY_ET0M at bit 14 and SSB_SPROM1_ETHPHY_ET1M at bit 15. SSB_SPROM1_BINF at 0x005C packs SSB_SPROM1_BINF_BREV at 0xFF, SSB_SPROM1_BINF_CCODE at 0xF00 shift 8, SSB_SPROM1_BINF_ANTBG at 0x3000 shift 12 and SSB_SPROM1_BINF_ANTA at 0xC000 shift 14.

Revision 1 continues with SSB_SPROM1_PA0B0 at 0x005E, SSB_SPROM1_PA0B1 at 0x0060 and SSB_SPROM1_PA0B2 at 0x0062, GPIO SSB_SPROM1_GPIOA at 0x0064 using SSB_SPROM1_GPIOA_P0 and SSB_SPROM1_GPIOA_P1 shift 8 plus SSB_SPROM1_GPIOB at 0x0066 using SSB_SPROM1_GPIOB_P2 and SSB_SPROM1_GPIOB_P3 shift 8, ceiling SSB_SPROM1_MAXPWR at 0x0068 using SSB_SPROM1_MAXPWR_BG and SSB_SPROM1_MAXPWR_A shift 8, second amp SSB_SPROM1_PA1B0 at 0x006A, SSB_SPROM1_PA1B1 at 0x006C and SSB_SPROM1_PA1B2 at 0x006E, idle SSB_SPROM1_ITSSI at 0x0070 using SSB_SPROM1_ITSSI_BG and SSB_SPROM1_ITSSI_A shift 8, flags SSB_SPROM1_BFLLO at 0x0072, gain SSB_SPROM1_AGAIN at 0x0074 using SSB_SPROM1_AGAIN_BG and SSB_SPROM1_AGAIN_A shift 8, and SSB_SPROM1_CCODE at 0x0076.

Revision 2 adds SSB_SPROM2_BFLHI at 0x0038, A-band ceiling SSB_SPROM2_MAXP_A at 0x003A using SSB_SPROM2_MAXP_A_HI at 0xFF and SSB_SPROM2_MAXP_A_LO at 0xFF00 shift 8, low amp SSB_SPROM2_PA1LOB0 at 0x003C, SSB_SPROM2_PA1LOB1 at 0x003E and SSB_SPROM2_PA1LOB2 at 0x0040, high amp SSB_SPROM2_PA1HIB0 at 0x0042, SSB_SPROM2_PA1HIB1 at 0x0044 and SSB_SPROM2_PA1HIB2 at 0x0046, offset SSB_SPROM2_OPO at 0x0078 with SSB_SPROM2_OPO_VALUE at 0xFF and SSB_SPROM2_OPO_UNUSED at 0xFF00, and SSB_SPROM2_CCODE at 0x007C.

Revision 3 defines A-band offsets SSB_SPROM3_OFDMAPO at 0x002C, SSB_SPROM3_OFDMALPO at 0x0030 and SSB_SPROM3_OFDMAHPO at 0x0034 as four-byte big-endian words, LED duty SSB_SPROM3_GPIOLDC at 0x0042 with SSB_SPROM3_GPIOLDC_OFF at 0xFF00 shift 8 and SSB_SPROM3_GPIOLDC_ON at 0xFF0000 shift 16, MAC SSB_SPROM3_IL0MAC at 0x004A, CCK SSB_SPROM3_CCKPO at 0x0078 using SSB_SPROM3_CCKPO_1M at 0xF, SSB_SPROM3_CCKPO_2M at 0xF0 shift 4, SSB_SPROM3_CCKPO_55M at 0xF00 shift 8 and SSB_SPROM3_CCKPO_11M at 0xF000 shift 12, and G-band SSB_SPROM3_OFDMGPO at 0x107A as a four-byte big-endian word.

Revision 4 opens with SSB_SPROM4_BOARDREV at 0x0042, SSB_SPROM4_BFLLO at 0x0044, SSB_SPROM4_BFLHI at 0x0046, SSB_SPROM4_BFL2LO at 0x0048, SSB_SPROM4_BFL2HI at 0x004A, SSB_SPROM4_IL0MAC at 0x004C and SSB_SPROM4_CCODE at 0x0052. GPIO uses SSB_SPROM4_GPIOA at 0x0056 with SSB_SPROM4_GPIOA_P0 and SSB_SPROM4_GPIOA_P1 shift 8, and SSB_SPROM4_GPIOB at 0x0058 with SSB_SPROM4_GPIOB_P2 and SSB_SPROM4_GPIOB_P3 shift 8. PHY at SSB_SPROM4_ETHPHY 0x005A mirrors revision 1 MII and MDIO bits. Antenna SSB_SPROM4_ANTAVAIL at 0x005C uses SSB_SPROM4_ANTAVAIL_BG and SSB_SPROM4_ANTAVAIL_A shift 8. Gains SSB_SPROM4_AGAIN01 at 0x005E and SSB_SPROM4_AGAIN23 at 0x0060 pack SSB_SPROM4_AGAIN0 through SSB_SPROM4_AGAIN3 with shift 8 for odd antennas.

Revision 4 TX indices each pack two antennas per 16-bit word with the upper byte at shift 8: SSB_SPROM4_TXPID2G01 at 0x0062 and SSB_SPROM4_TXPID2G23 at 0x0064 for 2 GHz, SSB_SPROM4_TXPID5G01 at 0x0066 and SSB_SPROM4_TXPID5G23 at 0x0068 for 5 GHz middle, SSB_SPROM4_TXPID5GL01 at 0x006A and SSB_SPROM4_TXPID5GL23 at 0x006C for 5 GHz low, and SSB_SPROM4_TXPID5GH01 at 0x006E and SSB_SPROM4_TXPID5GH23 at 0x0070 for 5 GHz high.

GPIO registers require PCI core revision 3 or later, the PCI IRQ mask requires revision 6 or later, initiator busy and reject plus target timeout require backplane revision 2.3 or later with separate reject bits for older versus 2.3 fabrics, and SPROM word count changes with SPROM revision rather than staying fixed.

SPROM control includes a write-enable bit that must be managed around PROM updates. Target and initiator status expose reset, reject, busy, timeout, in-band error, S-error and self-test failed or done indications, plus service and request timeout tuning, so ignoring them risks acting on a faulted fabric.
